count_reconciliation.meaning: At least 316 executed or result-bearing development cells are evidenced. This is not an exact historical trial count and may only increase after row-level review.
count_reconciliation.use_for_interim_deflation: Use 316 only as a conservative minimum program breadth when an interim calculation cannot wait for an attested row-level ledger. Do not encode 316 as a claim of exactness.

deduplication: Collapse an exact deterministic rerun only when the material dimensions and implementation/data identity are the same.
Retain multiple evidence runs under one cell after an exact-rerun determination.
Treat a bug fix, code change affecting behavior, different data feed/window, cost model, universe slice, portfolio form, or weighting rule as a distinct cell.
When identity cannot be established, do not silently collapse the records; mark the ambiguity for independent review.
excluded: proposed-only configurations with no evidence of execution
pure performance benchmarks that did not produce a strategy result
broker preview/place/cancel smoke checks with no alpha evaluation

groups.result_digest: The 2015-2024 result was about -0.1% with Sharpe -0.70 and PSR 0.01; the 2005-2024 robustness window returned about +5% over twenty years but failed risk-adjusted criteria.

The historical run reported 8/8 BH survivors and motivated an issuance desk, but used gross inference, a current-size-conditioned universe, same-close timing, and only 60bp total cost. The 2026-07-13 corrected run used observed SEP sessions, dated relative size terciles, T+1 entry, raw net HAC inference, and 120bp total fixed cost; 0/8 survived BH. The middle tercile was net -0.458% at 21d (p=0.8344) and +0.699% at 63d (p=0.2904). The candidate was stopped at development.
uncertainties: Neither run can qualify issuance-midcap-ls-v1 and the inspected period cannot be treated as a fresh holdout.
The corrected report retains complete dated inference arrays but not all raw event rows, ranks, or executable order evidence.

global_uncertainties: This is a grouped reconstruction, not a row-complete, independently reviewed ledger.
Ignored JSON and SQLite files are mutable and were not externally timestamped when created.
Many historical reports omit exact data snapshots, code identity, dependency lock, seed, complete configuration, costs, and raw return series.
Historical factor screens used gross-return inference while displaying net means and used current size labels; their significance claims are invalid.
The quality and multi-signal-fund group counts have the greatest deduplication uncertainty.
Additional attempts may exist in deleted files, local shells, notebooks, unmerged branches, or unpreserved CLI output.
All data inspected before a future sealed protocol is development data; none can be relabeled as a fresh holdout.
required_next_actions: Generate one row per recovered trial cell with a canonical deduplication key and evidence-run aliases.
Have an independent reviewer resolve every medium/low-confidence group and sign a content hash; attestation remains null until then.
Import the reviewed rows under one frozen legacy-development-backfill protocol, never as preregistered or qualifying evidence.
Increase, never decrease, the program trial breadth when additional documented attempts are recovered unless an exact duplicate is proven.
Keep issuance_midcap_ls_v1's future protocol, holdout, outcome, replication, paper, and deployment evidence separate from this inventory.
